title: THE ENEMY WILL NOT TOUCH THIS WEEK
text: You are standing at the threshold. The week has not yet begun. Monday has not yet opened its first hour. The days are unwritten. The appointments are unmet. The conversations have not yet been spoken. The decisions have not yet been made. The victories have not yet been won, and neither have the defeats. You are at the threshold, the most strategic position in the entire week, because what happens at the threshold determines what happens in every room beyond it. The enemy knows this. He knows that the threshold is where the week is won or lost. He knows that the believer who seals the threshold before stepping into Monday enters a different kind of week than the one who crosses without sealing. And so, he walks the threshold, the Sunday evening heaviness, the Sunday night anxiety about what Monday holds, the feeling at the threshold that the week beyond is already threatening. Already too much, already too hard, already determined to go a certain way. He walks the threshold because he knows if he can establish his presence there, if he can be the one who speaks into the week before it begins, he has a foothold from which to operate all seven days. But you are here at the threshold before Monday, and you are not coming to the threshold empty-handed. You are coming with the blood of Jesus, with the name that is above every name, with the authority of Luke 10:19, with the sealing power of Ephesians 1:13, the Holy Spirit of promise who seals what God claims. And before you step into Monday, you are going to seal this week. Not after the battle, before Monday morning, at the threshold, where the sealing changes everything that comes after. The enemy will not touch this week. Not a hope, not a request, a decree from the threshold. Spoken into the unwritten days before a single pen has marked them, the enemy with all his assembled strategies, all his deployed assignments, all his carefully timed attacks will not touch this week. Because the week will be sealed with the blood, with the word, with the fire of the Holy Ghost. And what is sealed by the living God cannot be unsealed by the defeated enemy. Revelation chapter 3 verse 7. He that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth and no man shutteth, and shutteth and no man openeth. The one who seals no man can unseal. No principality, no power, no demon with an assignment, no carefully crafted strategy from the dark council, the sealed week stands. Before the prayer, share this word. Because someone you know is about to enter Monday unsealed. Not because they are faithless, because no one showed them this threshold prayer. They will cross into Monday as they have every other Monday, hoping for the best, bracing for the worst. Send them this word. Let them seal the threshold before they cross it. Now, the revelation of the sealing. I want to show you three things from scripture about what it means to seal a week and why the enemy cannot touch what has been sealed. The first revelation, the seal is a mark of ownership. Ephesians chapter 1 verse 13. In whom he also trusted after that he heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, in whom also after that he believed, you were sealed with that Holy Spirit of promise. Sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise. The Greek word for sealed is fragizo. To set a seal upon, to mark with a seal, to stamp as one's own property. When a king in the ancient world sealed a document, he pressed his signet ring into warm wax. That impression was the mark of ownership. It said this belongs to me. It carries my authority. Anyone who breaks this seal answers to me. The Holy Spirit is God's seal upon the believer. The signet impression of heaven on the covenant child. It says this one belongs to God. This life carries his authority. Anyone, any principality, any power, any assignment that attempts to break this seal answers to the one who pressed it. The threshold prayer extends this sealing from the person to the territory of the week. The covenant child stands at the threshold and presses the signet of God into the warm wax of the unbegun week. This week belongs to God. It carries his authority. Anyone who attempts to break this seal answers to the one who pressed it. The second revelation, the seal, is a mark of protection. Exodus chapter 12. The night of Passover, death moving through Egypt. Every firstborn threatened. And God gives the instruction, verse 13, "And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where you are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you. And the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you. When I see the blood, I will pass over." The blood was the seal on the doorpost. The mark of protection, the signal to the death angel, this house has been sealed. Passover, the death angel was not negotiating. It was not evaluating the quality of the faith of the family inside. It was not assessing the spiritual maturity of the firstborn. It saw the blood and it passed over. The blood on the threshold was sufficient. Full stop. The threshold prayer applies the blood of Jesus to the doorpost of the week. Monday's doorpost sealed with blood. Tuesday's doorpost sealed with blood. Every day marked. And every assignment moving through the spirit realm this week sees the blood and passes over. Not because the attack was not assembled, because the threshold was sealed. The third revelation, the seal, is a mark of divine completion. Philippians chapter 1, verse 6. Being confident of this very thing, that he which had begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. He will perform it. Perform epiteleo, to complete, to bring to full accomplishment, to carry through to the designed end. The God who began the work in this life is committed to its completion. Not partial completion. Not completion up to the point of the enemy's interference. Full completion until the day of Jesus Christ. The sealed week is a week under divine completion. What God intended to accomplish in it, he will complete. What he intended to give in it, he will deliver. What he intended to open in it, he will open. What he intended to heal in it, he will heal. Not because nothing will try to stop it, because the seal marks it as God's completion project. And the enemy cannot stop what God has marked for completion. Three revelations, the seal of ownership, the seal of protection, the seal of divine completion. All three at the threshold. All three in this prayer. Now, before Monday morning at the threshold, we seal the week. Stand at the threshold, not inside the week yet, at its door. At the Sunday night to Monday morning threshold, the most strategic position in the entire prayer calendar. You are not asking God to protect the week. You are participating with him in sealing it. The strategizo prayer, the signet pressed into the warm wax of the unbegun days. The blood applied to the door post before the angel moves. The divine completion mark stamped onto the hours before they can become the stage for the enemy's counter plan. Father, I come to you at the threshold before Monday morning, before the first alarm, before the first decision, before the week can be claimed by anyone else. I come through the blood of Jesus Christ. The blood that gives me legal standing at this threshold. The blood that is the instrument of the sealing. Hebrews 10:19, boldness to enter by the blood. I enter boldly at the threshold with the seal, and I make seven sealing declarations over this week. Seven, the number of completion. Seven sealings over a seven-day week. Each day sealed, the whole week covered. Sealing one, I seal the week with the blood of Jesus. As Moses applied the blood to the door posts of Israel, I apply the blood of Jesus to the door posts of this week. Blood on Monday's door post. Every assignment moving toward Monday sees the blood, passes over. The plague does not enter, the attack cannot land. When God sees the blood, he passes over. When the enemy sees the blood, he has no legal entry. Blood on Tuesday's doorpost, the attack that was scheduled for Tuesday morning confronts the blood at the entrance. The blood has been there since before Monday began. The attack arrives, sees the blood, cannot enter. Blood on Wednesday's doorpost, the midweek pressure that was going to become a midweek collapse sealed at the door before it could enter. Blood on Thursday's doorpost, blood on Friday's doorpost, blood on the doorpost of the weekend, blood on the threshold of the entire week. Every door, every entrance, every point of potential entry sealed with the blood that has never lost its power. The blood of the lamb, Revelation 12:11, that overcomes. Week sealed with the blood. The enemy will not touch what the blood has covered. Sealing two, I seal the week with the name of Jesus. Proverbs chapter 18 verse 10. The name of the Lord is a strong tower. The righteous runneth into it and is safe. A strong tower. The name of the Lord, not just a label for the divine person, a tower, a structural fortress. The one who runs into it safe. Miss God set on high, inaccessible. I seal this week inside the strong tower of the name of Jesus. I build the tower around Monday. The name of Jesus as the structural walls of Monday. Every attack approaching Monday from any direction confronts the tower, cannot penetrate the name. I build the tower around the family. The name of Jesus as the inaccessible fortress around every member. The children inside the name, the marriage inside the name, the household set on high, inaccessible to the enemy's assault. I build a tower around the calling. The name of Jesus around the gift, the assignment, the ministry. The enemy who approaches the calling this week sees the tower first, and the tower is built with the name that is above every name. Above the name of the assignment against the calling, above the name of the principality over the territory, above every name that is named, Ephesians 1:21. Far above, the tower stands far above every opposition. Week sealed with the name. The enemy will not touch what stands inside the strong tower. Sealing three, I seal the week with the word of God. Psalm chapter 119, verse 105. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet and a light unto my path. A lamp, a light, not illuminating the destination from a distance, lighting the very next step, the immediate path. The word as the governing light over each day's decisions. I seal this week with the word of God. I speak the word over Monday's decisions. Before Monday can be governed by circumstances, the word governs it. James 1:2-5, wisdom given liberally. The wisdom of the word lighting every decision before the decision arrives. I speak the word over Tuesday's challenges. Philippians 4:13, I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me. All things, the Tuesday challenge included. The word sealed over Tuesday's challenges before they can declare their size. I speak the word over Wednesday's weariness. Isaiah 40:2-31, they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. The renewal sealed over Wednesday before the weariness can settle. I speak the word over Thursday's battles. Romans 8:37, we are more than conquerors through him that loved us. More than conquerors, hypernikao, super conquerors, overwhelmingly victorious. The victory is sealed over Thursday before the battle begins. I speak the word over Friday's fruit. Psalm 1 to 3, whatsoever he doeth shall prosper. The prosperity of the work sealed over Friday before the work is done. The word, a lamp over every day. Lighten the path before the foot can step into darkness. Governing the week before the week can govern itself. Week sealed with the word. The enemy will not touch what the living word governs. Sealing four, I seal the week with the fire of the Holy Spirit. Zechariah chapter 2 verse 5, for I sayeth the Lord will be unto her a wall of fire round about. And will be the glory in the midst of her. A wall of fire round about. Not a wall of stone, a wall of fire. Fire that the enemy cannot approach. Fire that consumes every assignment that attempts to cross it. Fire that burns all week long. Leviticus 6:13, the altar fire that never goes out. I seal this week with the wall of fire. Fire around the perimeter of Monday. The assignments approaching Monday from the north, south, east, and west. The wall is round about. Every direction, no gap. Fire around the finances of this week. The devorah approaching the financial territory. The fire wall stops it before it can reach the provision. Fire around the health of every person under this prayer. The sickness assignment approaching the body, fire at the boundary cannot cross. Fire around the children. Every road they travel this week, fire going before them. Every environment they enter, fire around their boundaries. What threatens the children from the outside meets fire before it reaches them. And in the midst of the firewall, the glory. Zechariah 2:2-5, glory in the midst. Not just protection, presence. Not just a sealed perimeter, a inhabiting glory. The week that is fire sealed on the outside and glory filled on the inside. Week sealed with the fire. The enemy will not touch what the fire of God surrounds. Sealing five, I seal the week with angelic assignment. Psalm chapter 91:11-12, for he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone. He shall give his angels charge. Charge shavar to command, to commission, to give a specific mandate. The angels are not casually present. They are commissioned, given specific orders to keep shamar, to guard, to watch over, to protect with diligent care in all thy ways. Every road, every journey, every day of the week. I release the angels of God into this week as the guardians of the sealed territory. Angels go into Monday before I arrive there. Prepare what must be prepared. Remove what must be removed. Guard the divine appointment so they are not stolen by destruction. Stand at the financial gate so the devourer cannot pass. Bear up in every moment that the enemy designed for a fall. Angels guard the journeys of this week. The commute, the travel, the road that the enemy had an accident assignment on, the accident assignment cancelled. The angels are on the road first. Angels guard the children in every environment this week. The school, the playground, the social space. Hebrews 1:14, ministering spirits sent to serve the heirs. They are sent this week specifically for the heirs. Angels stand at the threshold of the calling this week. Every door the enemy was going to close, angels standing in it holding it open. Every door the enemy was going to open to the counterfeit, angels shutting it before the foot crosses. Week sealed with angelic assignment. The enemy will not touch what the angels of God are guarding. Sealing six. I seal the week with prophetic declaration. Job chapter 22 verse 28. Thou shalt also decree a thing and it shall be established unto thee. The decree established. Not hoped for, not requested, decreed and therefore established. I seal this week with prophetic declarations that establish the week's outcome before it unfolds. I decree this week ends in testimony. Not in loss, not in regret, not in survival. In a story that begins, I prayed before Monday started and then let me tell you what God did. I decree every divine appointment of this week happens on schedule. The meeting God arranged takes place. The person God positioned is encountered. The conversation God prepared happens. None of the divine appointments are missed. The sealed week carries them all to completion. I decree the provision for this week arrives. From the expected direction it arrives. From the unexpected direction it arrives. Philippians 4:19, according to his riches in glory. The riches of heaven are the supply measure for this week. Not the economy, not the circumstance. His riches inexhaustible, unaffected by the enemy's interference. I decree the health of this week is maintained. Everybody under this prayer strong enough for the assignment. The sickness assignment does not land. The exhaustion does not collapse the mission. The health is established by the decree and sealed by the blood. I decree the calling advances this week. Something moves forward that has been stationary. Something is confirmed that has been uncertain. Something opens that has been closed. The calling sealed, protected, advancing. The enemy unable to touch what the decree has established. Week sealed with prophetic declaration. The enemy will not touch what the decree has established. Sealing seven. I seal the week with praise and thanksgiving. 2 Chronicles chapter 20. Jehoshaphat facing three armies. The battle too large for any natural strategy. And the divine instruction verse 17, "Ye shall not need to fight in this battle. Set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the Lord." And they go out to battle not with swords. Verse 21, "He appointed singers unto the Lord that should praise the beauty of holiness. Singers first before the army. And as they sang verse 22, the Lord set ambushements against the enemies. The enemies destroyed each other. The singers never raised a sword. The praise was the seal. And the sealed battle was won before Judah engaged. I seal this week with praise. Not because the week is already good, because God is already good. The praise that is not contingent on the week's performance, but on God's character. Father, you are faithful. In every previous week, faithful. In the week that is about to begin, faithful. In the weeks not yet visible from this threshold, faithful. Faithful. That does not change with Monday morning. Father, you are good. Psalm 136, his mercy endured forever. Every verse, every situation, his mercy forever. Into this week, his mercy. Into Monday, his mercy. Into the hard day in the middle of the week, his mercy. Enduring, not expiring, not exhausted by the previous weeks. Father, you are the God who completes. Philippians 1:36, he will perform it. What was begun will be completed. This week is not a random 7 days. It is 7 days in the ongoing completion of what God began. And he will perform it. The praise rising from the threshold before the battle, before the week. The singers going out first. And the ambushements of God being set against every enemy before the week begins. Week sealed with praise. The enemy will not touch what praise has sealed. Father, seven ceilings. The blood, the name, the word, the fire, the angels, the decree, the praise. Seven ceilings over seven days. The week completely, comprehensively, irrevocably sealed. The enemy will not touch this week. Not as aspiration, as legal reality. The blood applied, the name invoked, the word established as the governing force, the fire burning at every perimeter, the angels commissioned and deployed, the decree established and standing, the praise setting the divine ambushments. What he comes against he finds sealed. What he tries to enter he finds the blood. What he tries to attack he finds fire. What he tries to destroy he finds angels standing guard. What he tries to corrupt he finds the word already governing. The enemy will not touch this week. Father, there is a person under this voice who has been praying this kind of prayer and watching the week take a different route than the prayer described. They seal the week or try to and Monday arrive with the same weight, the same attack, the same pattern. And the question beneath the question is, does the sealing actually work? Is this prayer words or is it reality? The Lord says the sealing always works, but the evidence is not always visible in the way the believer expects. Sometimes a sealed week looks hard because hard and touched are not the same thing. Hard is the natural resistance of the territory. Touched is the enemy's uncontested access to the week. The sealed week can still be hard, but the enemy cannot touch what is hard. He can observe the difficulty, he cannot direct it. He can see the pressure, he cannot add to it. He can watch the challenge, he cannot control the outcome. The sealing is the removal of his access, not the removal of all resistance. And the person who prays this prayer and then goes through a hard but not destroyed week is experiencing the sealing, not his failure. I decree look back at the weeks you prayed. Look at what did not happen. The attack that was assembled but did not land. The relationship that was targeted but survived. The financial crisis that was scheduled but arrived muted. The health threat that presented but did not prevail. That is the sealing working. Not the absence of difficulty, the absence of destruction. Not the removal of challenge, the removal of the enemy's access to direct it. And a second word for the person who comes to this threshold carrying the weight of a broken season. Not one hard week, a sequence of them. Weeks that followed one another in a pattern that felt like the sealing had failed. Like the enemy had found a way through the blood. Like the firewall had gaps. The Lord says the blood does not fail. The fire does not have gaps. But there are seasons of testing that God permits within the sealed territory. As he permitted the testing of Job within clearly defined limits. Job 1:12, the Lord said unto Satan, "Behold, all that he hath is in thy power. Only upon himself put not forth thine hand." Even in the permitted testing, there were limits. And the one who came through the testing came through it sealed. The enemy touched what God permitted him to touch. He did not touch the life, the life was sealed. I decree the sequence of hard weeks is ending. This threshold prayer marks the beginning of a new sequence. A sealed week, then another sealed week, then another. The pattern that the enemy established, broken at this threshold, and the new pattern, the sealed pattern, begins with this Monday morning. We give you praise, Father. From the threshold, the praise of the singers going out before the army, the praise that sets the ambushments, the praise that is not waiting for the testimony, that is the as the beginning of the testimony. The week is sealed. The victory is sealed. The enemy does not have access. Shondai Ecclesia Tumbalashondaire Ecclesia. Kai Ecclesia Shondai Tumbalare. Raishondai Kai Ecclesia Tumbalare. The siege is over. You prayed before Monday morning. You stood at the threshold, the most strategic position in the entire week, and you sealed it. Seven sealings, seven days, one sealed week. The blood is on the doorposts. The name stands as the strong tower. The word governs every day. The fire burns at every perimeter. The angels are commissioned and deployed. The decree is established. The praise has set the divine ambushments. Walk into your favor. It has been waiting behind the sealed door, inside the blood-covered week, in the territory where the enemy cannot operate freely, where the fire burns at the boundary, where the angels guard the path, where the praise has already set ambushments against every enemy that thought it was walking into an open week. Your destiny is preserved by the blood. Your week is sealed by the seven sealings. And the God who seals, Revelation 3:2-7, he that openeth and no man shutteth, he that shutteth and no man openeth, sealed what you asked him to seal. And no man shall open it. No principality shall break it. No power shall unseal it. No ruler of darkness shall find a way through it. The week is sealed. The enemy will not touch it. From this altar you go as the one who sealed the threshold. The one who arrived before Monday. The one who pressed the signet of God into the warm wax of the unbegun days. The one who applied the blood before the angel moved. The one who send the singers out before the army. Now step across the threshold into the sealed week. Into the week the enemy cannot touch. Tumbala ecclesia shondire kaishondai tumbala reikai ecclesia shondai tumbala ecclesia reitumbala shondai kai. It is done. The threshold is sealed. The week is covered. Sealed with the blood, done. Sealed with the name, done. Sealed with the word, done. Sealed with the fire, done. Sealed with the angels, done. Sealed with the decree, done. Sealed with praise, done. The enemy will not touch this week. Cross the threshold. Amen and amen.
